title.en: NutriChatBot — Intelligent Nutrition & Diet Assistant with Hybrid RAG
title.id: NutriChatBot — Asisten Nutrisi & Pola Makan Cerdas dengan Hybrid RAG

domain.en: AI Nutrition & Health Assistant / Generative RAG
domain.id: Asisten Gizi & Kesehatan Berbasis AI / Generative RAG

summary.en: Production-grade nutritional assistant combining dense ChromaDB embeddings and lexical SQLite search via Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, powering verified dietary advice, layperson-friendly UI/UX chips, and Mifflin-St Jeor calculations via GLM-5.3-flash reasoning.
summary.id: Asisten nutrisi teruji yang memadukan pencarian semantik ChromaDB dan leksikal SQLite melalui Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, menghadirkan saran gizi berbasis data resmi pangan, UI/UX ramah pengguna awam, dan kalkulator Mifflin-St Jeor dengan penalaran GLM-5.3-flash.

problem.en: General-purpose LLMs frequently hallucinate nutritional values and lack contextual knowledge of authentic Indonesian dietary staples (DKBM data), while everyday laypersons struggle with blank-canvas chat paralysis, lack understanding of metabolic math (BMR/TDEE), and face safety risks without medical guardrails.
problem.id: LLM umum kerap mengalami halusinasi pada data takaran nutrisi dan minim memahami komposisi bahan pangan lokal Indonesia (DKBM), sementara masyarakat awam kerap bingung saat berhadapan dengan chat kosong (blank-canvas), kesulitan memahami rumus kalori (BMR/TDEE), serta rentan terhadap anjuran diet tanpa batasan keselamatan medis.

personalContribution.en: Designed and engineered the end-to-end architecture: implemented the Dual-Engine Hybrid RAG with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF), integrated the Mifflin-St Jeor metabolic formula, built medical risk detection guardrails and log redaction filters, designed user-centered UI/UX interactions for non-technical users (interactive prompt chips, quick comparative takeaways, BMI visual badges, and separated developer observability), crafted the official brand identity logo mark ('Smart Nutri-Leaf') integrated across app header, sidebar, and favicon, and established 100% passing automated test coverage with GitHub Actions CI.
personalContribution.id: Merancang dan membangun arsitektur menyeluruh: mengimplementasikan Hybrid RAG Dual-Engine dengan Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF), mengintegrasikan kalkulator metabolik formula Mifflin-St Jeor, membangun guardrail deteksi risiko medis dan filter redaksi log sensitif, merekayasa antarmuka UI/UX ramah pengguna awam (chip pertanyaan cepat, ringkasan perbandingan gizi instan, lencana status BMI, pemisahan telemetri teknis), merancang identitas merek dan logo vektor resmi ('Smart Nutri-Leaf') yang terintegrasi pada header aplikasi, sidebar, dan favicon, serta mendirikan cakupan pengujian otomatis berstatus 100% lulus pada GitHub Actions CI.

engineeringFocus.en: Dual-engine hybrid retrieval with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF) fusing vector cosine distance and lexical rank scoring; real-time streaming token generation; household serving size (URT) translation layer; authentic regional recipe library; FMCG retail database with Nutri-Score; strict regex credential redaction; comprehensive 68-test verification pyramid.
engineeringFocus.id: Hybrid retrieval dual-engine dengan Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF) yang menyatukan jarak kosinus vektor dan pemeringkatan leksikal; inferensi streaming token real-time; lapisan translasi ukuran rumah tangga (URT); pustaka resep masakan nusantara otentik; basis data produk ritel FMCG dengan Nutri-Score; redaksi kredensial sensitif berbasis regex nir-bocor; serta piramida verifikasi 68 uji otomatis.

architecture.en: Layered architecture comprising Streamlit Web UI with Custom CSS, Guardrails & Preprocessing Engine, Dual-Engine Retrieval Pipeline (Dense Semantic via ChromaDB + Lexical Ranked via SQLite), Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion Re-ranking, and SumoPod AI GLM-5.3-flash Streaming Inference.
architecture.id: Arsitektur berlapis yang terdiri atas Streamlit Web UI dengan Custom CSS, Engine Guardrail & Pra-pemrosesan, Pipeline Retrieval Dual-Engine (Semantik Dense via ChromaDB + Leksikal Terurut via SQLite), Pemeringkatan Ulang Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion, dan Inferensi Streaming SumoPod AI GLM-5.3-flash.

implementation.en: Built on Python 3.12 with clean service separation: services/database.py for parameterized SQLite queries, services/embeddings.py for text-embedding-3-small and ChromaDB vector operations, services/nutrition_calc.py for validated Mifflin-St Jeor math, services/llm.py for streaming GLM inference with safety guardrails, and app.py for multi-view Streamlit UI featuring accessible prompt chips and custom design tokens.
implementation.id: Dibangun di atas Python 3.12 dengan pemisahan modul yang rapi: services/database.py untuk kueri berparameter SQLite, services/embeddings.py untuk text-embedding-3-small dan ChromaDB, services/nutrition_calc.py untuk validasi formula Mifflin-St Jeor, services/llm.py untuk inferensi streaming GLM dengan guardrail medis, dan app.py untuk antarmuka multi-tampilan Streamlit yang dilengkapi chip pertanyaan cepat dan token desain kustom.

technicalDecisions.decision: Hybrid Retrieval with Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (wRRF)
technicalDecisions.rationale: Pure vector search struggles with exact Indonesian culinary naming (e.g., 'Beras giling merah' vs 'Beras ketan'), while pure keyword search fails on semantic queries (e.g., 'makanan tinggi protein rendah lemak'). wRRF with k=60 achieves the optimal balance of precision and recall.

technicalDecisions.decision: User-Centered Design (UCD) with Quick Prompt Chips & Separated Developer Drawer
technicalDecisions.rationale: Laypersons frequently experience decision paralysis when facing a blank text input, while developer metrics (model IDs, embedding dimensions, vector counts) create visual clutter. Embedding interactive quick-action chips and relegating technical metrics to an expander drawer drastically lowers cognitive barriers while maintaining system observability.

technicalDecisions.decision: SumoPod AI Gateway with GLM-5.3-flash Model
technicalDecisions.rationale: Provides cost-effective, high-throughput inference with strong multi-step clinical reasoning and streaming token delivery via standard OpenAI-compatible client.

technicalDecisions.decision: Mifflin-St Jeor Equation for Biometric Calculation
technicalDecisions.rationale: Widely recognized by the American Dietetic Association (ADA) as the most clinically accurate predictive equation for resting metabolic rate in non-obese and obese individuals compared to legacy Harris-Benedict.

SQLite provides ACID compliance, fast exact-match lookups, and aggregate analytical capability, while ChromaDB provides localized persistent high-dimensional vector search without expensive cloud managed vector database overhead.

technicalDecisions.decision: Visual Brand Identity & Vector Logo Mark ('Smart Nutri-Leaf')
technicalDecisions.rationale: Elevates consumer trust, visual recognition, and aesthetic warmth for non-technical users by integrating a cohesive vector logo across headers, sidebar badges, and browser favicons, replacing generic text emojis.

proof.testSuite: 68 automated pytest unit, integration, and UI tests (100% pass rate)
proof.qaSuite: 18 specialized QA end-to-end regression tests (18/18 passing)
proof.codeQuality: Ruff linter clean, zero lint errors, PEP 8 and typing compliance
proof.datasetSize: 1,346 DKBM foods + 60 FMCG packaged products (Nutri-Score A-E) + 30 authentic regional recipes + URT conversion engine

limitations.en: Evaluated on local environments and comprehensive automated test suites; public multi-user production telemetry is unverified; AI responses serve educational guidance and strictly include medical disclaimers rather than substituting for certified clinical dietitian advice.
limitations.id: Diuji pada lingkungan lokal dan rangkaian pengujian otomatis komprehensif; telemetri produksi publik skala multi-pengguna belum terverifikasi; seluruh saran AI bersifat edukatif dan menyertakan disclaimer medis wajib, bukan pengganti konsultasi dokter gizi klinis berlisensi.
